shared_elements: a single dominant living figure occupying the whole field
parallel incised lines used to render surface detail (garment folds / feather rows)
justification: The only correspondence is the most generic one: each surface is dominated by a single living figure whose body detail is rendered with rows of parallel incised lines (drapery in A, feathers in B). Otherwise the subjects are unrelated — A shows a standing human in low relief with an elaborate headdress and a small subsidiary figure at his feet in a narrative scene, while B is a fully three-dimensional hook-beaked bird with folded wings and no accompanying elements.
